meta.how_to_fill: Open each sheet, look at every frame, fill the empty fields in seconds[] and events[]. Then run: python3 ref_breakdown.py md <this folder>
meta.filled_by: machine facts (60 fps decode: motion, cuts, colours, audio onsets) + Tab's own viewing of 2 fps contact sheets (every 0.5 s). Rows are marked viewed; nothing here claims every 60 fps frame was looked at by eye.

summary: 3-panel layout: banner 'EDITING TIMELINE' / the edit in a rounded card / 'DM FOR PAID EDIT' strip / timeline recording.
Captions: 1-2 words, colour per word, pop every ~0.5 s; background plates swap (flag, classroom, anime school) as the story demands.
Only the creator talking carries the edit: 36 s with ~10 plate swaps.
make_it_ours: Banner in ink + amber gradient (no cyan)

Captions: ref8 style (gradient keyword + italic accent)
Warm paper blur background behind the panels
